title_en: Chinese Companies (2/20): Tencent, from QQ to WeChat
note_en: Chinese can't put a number straight before a noun; it needs a measure word, and the choice depends on the noun: 一家通信公司 "a telecom company" (家 for businesses), 几位朋友 "a few friends" (位, a polite word for people), 这款应用 "this app" (款 for product models), 这笔投资 "this investment" (笔 for sums of money). English does this only with mass nouns ("a sum of money"), so learn each noun together with its measure word.
